Trail Blazers 116Spurs 111

Avdija’s bank three holds off Wembanyama’s 44

Final · Wed, Nov 25 · Portland

Portland beat San Antonio 116–111, a 5-point home win. The Trail Blazers move to 12–6; the Spurs fall to 15–4.

Trail Blazers 116, Spurs 111

Blazers up 3 at the half, won the fourth 32–24

Outside the arc is where the Trail Blazers pulled ahead. Also +8 assists (29 vs 21). Enough to win 116–111.
